summary: Produced the backend design artefact for OBS-04 instance timeline at src/design/obs-04-instance-timeline.md. The design fully specifies GET /instances/:id/timeline route behavior, any-authenticated-role authorization, strict ascending chronological ordering with deterministic tie-breaks, API-06 pagination semantics, 404 behavior for missing instances, timeline entry schema and rendering rules, archived-event inclusion strategy spanning events and events_archive, actor display-name resolution and automated/token fallback logic, CANCELLED-instance complete-history behavior including INSTANCE_CANCELLED, index and performance guidance, failure semantics, and a full requirement-to-design traceability matrix with implementation and test hooks.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Validated all handoff acceptance criteria and OBS-04 edge cases against explicit design sections and traceability rows, including pagination, archived-event inclusion, actor fallback, and CANCELLED-instance history behavior.
